division_by_large_scale.classification: shader relied on fdiv with divisors above 2^126, outside the Vulkan fdiv precision guarantee; AGX computes a * rcp(b) and the reciprocal underflows to a flushed denormal. hk/precise-math fdiv inherits the 0. Reported to HkIntegrateDriver as a precision gap, fixed here in the shader (category b).

int8(130.0f).note: wraps through int32 on both ISAs, so the int8/uint8 wrap pins hold everywhere

float_to_int32.classification: test oracle pinned x86 wrap for the INT32_MAX round trip; OpConvertFToS out of range is undefined and upstream CPU on aarch64 saturates (category c)

sinh_reassociation.mechanism: nir_opt_algebraic inexact fmul constant reassociation (rules '~fmul(fmul(a,#b),c) -> fmul(fmul(a,c),b)' and its mirror, mesa e10be728 nir_opt_algebraic.py lines 2405/3624) hoists the 0.5 in sh past both h multiplies; (1 - inverse) * cx * h * h = 0.97 * e^89 overflows before the 0.5. Spec-legal without NoContraction (category b).

tan_at_fl_pi_over_2.stock: cos(1.5707964f) = 0 -> complex tan denominator sh^2 + cb^2 = 0 -> NaN; inside the Vulkan 2^-11 absolute envelope for cos, so not a defect
tan_at_fl_pi_over_2.in_source_payne_hanek: elementwise.comp's sin_impl/cos_impl are documented dead on this driver (2026-09-02, dynamic-index shift miscompile), so the complex shader cannot borrow them
tan_at_fl_pi_over_2.classification: driver precision requirement (hk/precise-math, fork 979453d); test probes the builtin and names the requirement (category a, already handed over in the precise-math receipt)

overlay/mlx/backend/omarchy/shaders/comp: complex_log_magnitude: ratio = ldexp(min, -e) / mantissa instead of min / max
complex_sqrt: normalize with ldexp by an even exponent, root_scale = 2^(e/2)
complex_atan small-log-difference branch: ldexp scaling of (x, y - 1), y and 4
case 16 log1p large branch: reuse complex_log_magnitude(x + 1, y) (drops the scale division)
case 12/13 sinh/cosh: precise on (factors * h) * h
overlay/tests/omarchy/test_complex_ops.c: integer round: drop the INT32_MAX element whose float round trip has undefined int32 conversion; INT32_MIN stays

large-magnitude tan: probe cos(fl(pi/2)) on the device; when the builtin returns exactly 0 skip that single point with the named hk/precise-math requirement, otherwise keep the -2.2877e7 pin; tanh keeps all three points
